env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_opt_eval.lgo eval/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_opt_recv_value.lgo recv/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_opt_args.lgo args/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_opt_lambda.lgo lambda/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_opt_chain.lgo chain/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_opt_field.lgo field/main.lgo

cd eval
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_opt_eval.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_opt_eval.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_opt_eval.out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

cd recv
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_opt_recv_value.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_opt_recv_value.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_opt_recv_value.out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..
